meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速理解不熟悉的代码片段或模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand unfamiliar code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会深入解释代码库中某个文件、函数或模块的作用、内部结构、外部连接和数据流，并假设你不懂编程语言。
howto.when: 当你要求解释代码库中的特定组件（如文件路径或函数名）时触发。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件是做什么的。
say.note: Claude 会分析该文件在架构中的角色和内部结构。

say.text: 帮我理解 verifyToken 这个函数。
say.note: Claude 会查找该函数并解释其输入、输出和依赖关系。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude provides a thorough explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase, covering its role, internal structure, external connections, and data flow, assuming the reader may not know the programming language.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a deep-dive explanation of a specific code component, such as a file path or function name.

say_en.text: Explain what the file src/auth/login.ts does.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes its role in the architecture and internal structure.

say_en.text: Help me understand the verifyToken function.
say_en.note: Claude finds the function and explains its inputs, outputs, and dependencies.
